purpose: Import and independently accept the frozen synthetic v1.0.2 dataset, then run the current 72-case baseline/FIFO/adaptive experiment using the same reviewed 18-seed starting pool.
known_limitations: Original JSON/SQL/SQLite bytes and original absolute paths are preserved. Historical summaries are evidence, not rewritten portable manifests. Full re-execution of seed initialization/review on another root still requires path-aware source verification.
The seed-era public prompt is retained only under provenance/seed-era and is not installed over the current prompt.

The historical database acceptance report is stored only under provenance/original-environment. The user must generate a new database acceptance report after importing into the destination environment.
The two SQLite files were packaged as opaque bytes, without opening them or running integrity queries. Their original summary metadata declares 18 seeds.
MPS seed vectors require a copied-store index rebuild when the destination uses CPU; the original stores must remain unchanged.

Earlier v2.1 generation inputs and v1.0.0/v1.0.1 candidate datasets are not included. Their recorded hashes remain in build_provenance.json. This bundle imports the frozen v1.0.2 dataset and does not claim end-to-end regeneration from those earlier datasets.
Embedding weights, Python packages, model/API credentials, MySQL installation, and new experiment outputs are not included.
